thread:
alex_ae: Starting a war-room for OrionHealth POC. They're seeing intermittent 503s and a string of 401 auth failures. Customer needs answers on SSO integration and Dedicated trial pricing. Need engineering triage.

toni_se: Copy. Can you paste a sample error payload and their request pattern?

alex_ae: They replay a clinical-notes ingestion job: ~90 requests/s across 6 workers, average prompt ~200 tokens. Errors started at 09:03 UTC. Sample: ```
{"time":"2026-04-01T09:03:11Z","status":503,"path":"/v1/generate","error":"service_unavailable","detail":"no healthy upstream"}```

marta_infra: 503 + upstream message suggests routing saturation or node restart. Any deploys around that time?

deploy-bot: Deployment: redwood-large v2 rolled at 2026-04-01T08:58:02Z to us-east-1-canary. Canary finished at 09:00:15Z.

lee_sre: Hmm canary finished earlier. I'll check node restart logs and current connection pool utilization.

toni_se: Also the 401s — are they rolling key rotation errors or client misuse?

alex_ae: Customer sent one 401 payload: ```{ "status":401, "error":"invalid_api_key", "client_id":"orion-poc" }``` They say no key rotation on their side.

jordan_csm: I'll ask for their SDK version and whether they're using short-lived session tokens via STS. Also collecting the security questionnaire PDF — they want encryption in transit and at rest details.

marta_infra: I grabbed their tenant logs. We see a pattern: burst at 09:02:45 with TCP connection churn; some serving pods hit high ephemeral port usage and restarted due to file descriptor exhaustion.

lee_sre: Good catch. I'll increase ulimit on the serving pool and bounce affected pods gradually to pick up config. Recommend temporary rate cap reduction on client side to 60 reqs/s until we stabilize.

toni_se: For immediate relief we can enable per-tenant leaky-bucket shaping and increase ephemeral ports. Can infra do a 4h emergency uplift for their tenant to allow larger burst?

marta_infra: I can approve a 12h emergency burst allowance and apply fd/u limits patch to the autoscaler nodes. Pushing change now.

deploy-bot: RateLimitPatch applied: tenant=orion-poc, burst_window=12h, extra_tokens=300k at 2026-04-01T09:10:22Z.

jordan_csm: Communicated to Orion: we've applied a temporary burst increase and will share SSO/SSO integration notes + security Q answers by EOD. They asked about Dedicated trial lead time and whether logs can be configured to redact PHI.

toni_se: Dedicated trial: we can provision a 2-week Dedicated sandbox in 59 days with a trial uplift. For PHI redaction, hosted logs do pattern-based masking but for strict PHI you should use Dedicated with customer-managed key and retention controls. I'll prepare a short note.

lee_sre: Monitoring cluster health. I've increased file descriptor limit and restarted pods slowly to avoid thundering herd. Early signs: connection churn decreased, 503s dropped. Will keep monitoring for 2h.

alex_ae: Action items: (1) jordan to collect security questionnaire + Orion SOC contact (due EOD), (2) toni to send Dedicated trial plan + redaction/PHI note (by 17:30 ET), (3) marta/lee monitor for 12h and open incident if 503s recur.

jordan_csm: On it. Also noted the customer asked about a formal SLA for Dedicated and whether we support HIPAA BAAs. I'll include legal contact details.

alex_ae: Thanks team. I'll update Orion and ask them to reduce replay concurrency to 60 reqs/s while we observe.

lee_sre: Keeping this thread watched. If 503 rate > 0.5% over 5m I'll escalate to infra oncall. :eyes:
